newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Taleban say ex-President Najibullah hanged.
newsitem.headline: Taleban say ex-President Najibullah hanged.

text.p: Taleban commanders said on Friday they had hanged former Afghan president Najibullah and his brother Shahpur Ahmadzai after the capture of Kabul.
The bodies of the two men were hanging from a concrete traffic-control post at the gates of the presidential palace as a crowd of more than a thousand people crowded around to watch.
"We killed him because he was the murderer of our people," Noor Hakmal, a Taleban commander who entered the city from Charasyab, south of Kabul overnight, told Reuters.
Reuters correspondent Alistair Lyon saw Najibullah's body, battered and bloody, hanging with a steel wire noose around the neck.
Hakmal said the Taleban was searching the city for President Burhanuddin Rabbani, Prime Minister Gulbuddin Hekmatyar and military chief Ahmad Shah Masood but there was no word on their whereabouts.
The burly Najibullah had lived in the United Nations office in Kabul since April 1992 when he was ousted by mujahideen guerrilla forces after 14 years of civil war.
